Priya R.: Quick alignment request — AtlasPay EBR dry-run next week. Can we lock Thu 9:00am PT for a 45m run-through? Need: slide owners, latest onboarding health, renewal risk summary, enablement asks + feedback capture. Deck link: gs://redwood/qbrs/atlaspay-2026-v3.pptx

Maya S.: Thu 9 works for me. I’ll own the onboarding health slide — will pull DAU, activation funnel, and top 3 blockers.

Liam K.: I can take renewal-risk + commercial timeline. Need latest contract dates + any pending PO notes. @Carlos G. can you confirm demo environment availability?

Carlos G.: Demo env reserved — staging-42 booked Thu 8:30–10:00 PT. I’ll add a short latency/improvement notes slide. Also will attach demo run commands to the deck.

Emma T.: I’ll own enablement & feedback capture. Planning to include NPS trend, survey highlights, and top support tickets. Can someone share the latest survey CSV?

Priya R.: Two key asks: 1) Deck with slide content in by Wed EOD so we have time to polish. 2) Executive one-pager (200 words max) summarizing status + asks for the execs.

Maya S.: I’ll draft the 200w executive blurb and post it in this thread by Wed noon.

Liam K.: FYI renewal risk signal = 0.62 (threshold >0.6 flagged). I’ll include impact estimate (ARR at risk) and mitigation runbook. Ship my slides by Wed EOD.

Carlos G.: Demo run snippet I’ll add to the notes section:
```
# quick demo prep
kubectl port-forward svc/atlas-pay-demo -n staging 8080:80
curl -X POST https://staging-42.redwood.internal/demo -d '{"account_id": "atlas-123"}'
```

Emma T.: Can we add a short enablement ask: 30-min customer-facing training slot during the week after EBR? Need to confirm trainer availability.

Priya R.: Good call. Add that as an explicit ask on the exec one-pager (trainer + 1 follow-up office hours). Also: capture two renewal-owner decisions in the slide — renew as-is or propose concession.
